reasoning_content:
Wait, the `COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib /usr/local/lib` line — the node image's /usr/local/lib could be overwritten, and the backup in /usr/local/etc won't be touched. OK.

So let's resume the build. The previously failed build has consumed some layers. Let's re-run `docker compose up -d --build` in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose_up2.log 2>&1 &
echo started
